title: Cartier equality
statement: Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension ($K=k(b_1,\dots,b_m)$ for finitely many $b_i\in K$). Then the $K$-vector spaces $\Omega_{K/k}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] and $H_1(L_{K/k})$ (first homology of the naive cotangent complex of the canonical presentation $k[K]\to K$, [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]) are finite dimensional and $$\operatorname{trdeg}_k(K)=\dim_K\Omega_{K/k}-\dim_KH_1(L_{K/k}),$$ $\operatorname{trdeg}$ the transcendence degree (the cardinality of a transcendence basis [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis]). In particular, if $K/k$ is finite then $\dim_K\Omega_{K/k}=\dim_KH_1(L_{K/k})<\infty$.

proof.text: From finite field generation, use [lem-weil-pbc-finitely-generated-field-finite-transcendence-basis] to choose a finite transcendence basis, reindex it by Fin d, and enumerate a finite generating set by Fin m. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finitely-generated-field-complete-intersection-model] to obtain n, c, f, c ≤ n, n - c = d, f.length = c, a domain A = k[X_1,...,X_n]/(f), and a k-algebra equivalence Frac(A) ≃ K.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-fraction-field-cotangent-model] to f and the fraction-field equivalence. It gives a K-linear map δ : K^c → K^n and K-linear equivalences H_1(L_{K/k}) ≃ ker δ and Ω_{K/k} ≃ coker δ. Submodules and quotients of finite-dimensional coordinate spaces are finite dimensional, so transport finiteness across these equivalences.

Rank-nullity [lem-weil-pbc-idempotent-charpoly-rank-nullity] gives dim(range δ) + dim(ker δ) = c; the quotient dimension formula gives dim(coker δ) + dim(range δ) = n. With c ≤ n and n-c=d, cancellation in the natural numbers gives d + dim H_1 = dim Ω. The cardinality of the chosen transcendence basis equals trdeg [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Cast the natural-number equality to Cardinal, obtaining the untruncated formula. A finite extension is algebraic and has transcendence degree zero; substitute zero and use injectivity of natural-number casts to obtain the final equality.

lean.statement:
theorem cartier_equality
    (k K : Type*) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (hfg : (⊤ : IntermediateField k K).FG) :
    Module.Finite K (KaehlerDifferential k K) ∧
      Module.Finite K (Algebra.H1Cotangent k K) ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k K + Module.finrank K (Algebra.H1Cotangent k K) =
        Module.finrank K (KaehlerDifferential k K) ∧
      (FiniteDimensional k K →
        Module.finrank K (KaehlerDifferential k K) =
          Module.finrank K (Algebra.H1Cotangent k K))

reviewed_lean.note: k K fields, Algebra k K, FiniteType = f.g. extension; Module.Finite of KaehlerDifferential and H1Cotangent (Generators.self = canonical k[K]->K) = finite dim; trdeg + finrank H1 = finrank Omega in Cardinal (fixed: was toNat/truncated ℕ subtraction, weaker); FiniteDimensional k K -> finrank Omega = finrank H1
